scope: Educational Boards & Regulatory Bodies, Universities, Entrance Exams, and Scholarships for Telangana & Andhra Pradesh plus genuinely national-level entities (architected to extend to all 40 briefed education domains and all Indian states without schema change)

datasets_blocked.name: Schools (Government/Private/Residential/KV/Navodaya/Sainik/Gurukul/Welfare)
datasets_blocked.reason: Directory scale (tens of thousands of institutions) exceeds what per-institution search-snippet research can verify at the requested field depth
datasets_blocked.unblock_requires: Bulk structured data export (e.g. UDISE+ access) rather than per-institution web research

environment_constraint: Direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.edu.in/Wikipedia domains was blocked by this session's organizational egress policy (confirmed HTTP 403 policy denial). All data collected via WebSearch result snippets only; confidence scores calibrated accordingly. See docs/METHODOLOGY.md.
dependencies: No hard foreign-key dependency on Package001_Geography in v1.0.0 — state/jurisdiction fields are free-text values, not district_id references. Wiring to Package001_Geography's geographic primary keys is future work (see acquisition_backlog.json). Future packages requiring education anchoring may in turn depend on this package.

source_tiers_not_used: Priority 2 (Official social media — not needed this release)
Priority 4 (Community sources — excluded per package policy for factual data)

confidence_statistics.note: Capped below Package001_Geography's 85-95 band due to this session's WebFetch restriction — see docs/METHODOLOGY.md confidence_calibration section

See docs/METHODOLOGY.md.
